user.title: BLE Pairing / Discovery
user.description: Home Assistant will guide you through Bluetooth pairing to retrieve the cloud credentials needed for normal operation.

ble_discovery.title: BLE Pairing / Discovery
ble_discovery.description: Make sure your chlorinator is powered on and nearby. Home Assistant will keep watching over Bluetooth. When Halo appears, enable Pair Mode on the chlorinator panel; Home Assistant will continue automatically when the ready advertisement appears.

ble_discovery_timeout.title: No Chlorinator Found
ble_discovery_timeout.description: No Halo chlorinator was found over Bluetooth in time. Check power, range, and Bluetooth availability, then try again.

manual.title: Manual Setup
manual.description: Enter your chlorinator credentials manually. After validation, you can choose the Home Assistant device name and optional area.

device_details.title: Device Details
device_details.description: Choose how Halo {serial_number} should appear in Home Assistant.

ble_confirm.title: Chlorinator Found
ble_confirm.description: Found {name}. Enable Pair Mode on the chlorinator panel and Home Assistant will continue automatically when Halo is ready.

wait_for_pairing.title: Waiting for Pairing Mode
wait_for_pairing.description: Enable Pair Mode on the chlorinator panel. Home Assistant is actively watching for the ready pairing advertisement.

pairing_timeout.title: Pairing Timeout
pairing_timeout.description: Home Assistant did not see a ready pairing advertisement in time. Check power, range, and Pair Mode on the chlorinator panel, then try again.

ble_username.title: Pair Mode Detected
ble_username.description: Halo is ready to pair. Enter the username to register on the chlorinator. This will be used for cloud access. Max 14 characters.

ble_pair_failed.title: Pairing Failed
ble_pair_failed.description: BLE pairing did not complete. Check that the chlorinator is still in pairing mode, then try again.

progress.ble_discovery_found_waiting: Found Halo. Waiting for Pair Mode...
progress.ble_discovery_ready: Pair Mode detected. Ready to pair...
progress.wait_for_pairing: Found Halo. Waiting for Pair Mode...

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the chlorinator. Check credentials and ensure the chlorinator is online.
error.pairing_timeout: Pairing timed out. Make sure the chlorinator is in pairing mode and nearby.
error.pairing_failed: BLE pairing failed. The chlorinator may have rejected the request.
error.bleak_not_installed: BLE support is not available. Install bleak and ensure Bluetooth is available in Home Assistant.
error.username_too_long: Username must be 14 characters or less.
